runs.name: CUDA smoke test
runs.description: Torch and the GPU only: a real matmul on the device, plus torch.version.cuda beside the compute capability. Ten seconds, and the first thing to run on a new machine or after any driver or wheel change.

runs.name: Score the companion thresholds
runs.description: Reads the six companion-comparison reports back and scores the criterion declared before the run. Stdlib only, no GPU, seconds: the cheapest end-to-end check that the console can run something real.

runs.name: Generate folds for one signal
runs.description: Fifteen generator runs -- three splits for each of five folds -- under one directory, agreeing on the fold count, salt and seed derivation.

runs.name: Merge the six fold trees
runs.description: Reads the six per-signal fold trees and writes one merged tree beside them, ready for joint multi-head training. Nothing is regenerated. Stdlib only.

runs.name: Arm B: fine-tune one signal
runs.description: Every layer unfrozen, across five folds, roughly two minutes a fold on a 12GB card. The base model is named explicitly rather than left to the CLI default, so the numbers can be read beside a committed report.
